caption: : Avg. performance across 11 datasets (y-axis) with inference-based methods (x-axis) applied to -trained (Ours) and Standard instruction-tuned models.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average performance across 11 datasets for two different model training methods, “Standard” and “Ours”, applied to three base models. The horizontal axis represents the base model, labeled “Base”, “CORG”, and “AdaCAD” in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “Average Performance” and has a linear scale ranging from 48 to 62, with tick marks at intervals of 2. For each base model, there are two bars representing the two training methods: “Standard” is represented by a gray bar and “Ours” is represented by a blue bar, positioned side-by-side. The “Standard” bar for “Base” extends to approximately 57.5, while the “Ours” bar reaches approximately 61. For “CORG”, the “Standard” bar extends to approximately 57, and the “Ours” bar reaches approximately 61.25. Finally, for “AdaCAD”, the “Standard” bar reaches approximately 57.75 and the “Ours” bar extends to a height of around 61.5. The bars are arranged in alphabetical order by base model name, and no bars are visually emphasized.
